title: Purple Rain
notes:
This release includes John L. Nelson for 'Computer Blue' word and music credits, opposed to other versions that exclude him. (It can be found on dust jacket, last paragraph of credits.)

Sticker on shrink:
Music from Prince's dramatic feature film debut "[url=https://www.discogs.com/master/388665]Purple Rain[/url]" featuring "[m=157532]" & "[m=16212]" also includes limited edition full color poster (1-25110)
